title: Hourly to Salary Converter - Annual Salary Calculator 2024
excerpt: Convert your hourly wage to annual salary instantly. Compare job offers and understand your true earnings with our free converter.
content:
Converting hourly wage to annual salary helps you compare job offers and understand your true earning potential.

## Formula

**Annual Salary = Hourly Rate × Hours per Week × 52 Weeks**

Example: $25/hour × 40 hours × 52 = $52,000/year

## Common Conversions

- $15/hour = $31,200/year
- $20/hour = $41,600/year
- $25/hour = $52,000/year
- $30/hour = $62,400/year
- $50/hour = $104,000/year
- $75/hour = $156,000/year

## Benefits of Knowing Your Rate

1. Compare job offers fairly
2. Negotiate salary confidently
3. Budget effectively
4. Understand overtime worth
